material.identity: Self-created teaching scenario; no private project data or third-party imagery.

workflow: A writes the storyline, per-page demonstration tasks and complete body copy.
C integrates the content into one authoritative native PowerPoint file.
A reviews the saved text and all four rendered pages; the coordinator verifies rendering, charts and native animation video.

content_review.observed: The page bodies explain work, mechanism, records and next actions. Figures support those explanations. Relevant conditions remain beside their claims.

text_bound_warnings.review: Two conservative width warnings were checked against actual renders; text was complete and did not obstruct adjacent content.

animation.observed_method: PowerPoint CreateVideo; reviewed entry, intermediate and final states from the native-rendered video.
animation.observed_result: Body copy and supporting objects appear in explanation order; previous context remains visible.

repair_record: During integration, numeric output indices were initially interpreted as a chart series. They were changed to text categories; the saved charts, markers, threshold lines and both embedded workbooks were rechecked.
comparison_scope: An initial same-material single-author baseline and candidate were retained locally. The final candidate adds a dedicated content author and a handoff revision; this is a demonstrated workflow, not an author-count-controlled blind comparison or proof of universal improvement.

publication.sanitization: Removed Office author/company metadata; replaced only material and content-brief absolute paths in speaker notes with published relative filenames.
